purpose: Trace the complete vendor QMS series to its firmware-specific adaptation; this file is not activation proof

adaptations.status: Actual C precision/state tests passed; variable HDMI timing not enabled
differences: Bounded lookup
Exact rational rates
Two documented upstream table corrections

adaptations.vendor_area: rockchip_drm_drv.h and rockchip_drm_vop2.c: hdmi_vrr CRTC state, duplicate/reset, IRQ timing updates

adaptations.vendor_area: dw-hdmi-qp.c/h: class1 VTEM payload, TX_EN, next_tfr/m_const state and setup refresh

differences: Write only owned scheduler bit9
Track ownership before a possibly partial write
Verify power and expected TX_EN at completion

adaptations.vendor_area: dw_hdmi-rockchip.c: enable/rate-change/disable work, real vsync waits and encoder reset
adaptations.status: Lifecycle policy/native-wrapper injection tests and actual table preparation passed; callbacks not published
differences: Absolute command deadlines with independent status publication
Native failure recovery and foreign-mode preservation
PM route also guarded before suspend
Fresh link/HDR qualification required after resume

adaptations.status: Private ioctl/HWC candidate compiled and isolated tests passed; actual endpoint not registered
differences: Versioned private syscall instead of pretending the old firmware implements the new DRM property
Successful logical HWC config requires a real completed native ticket

adaptations.vendor_area: Board prerequisites for the vendor QMS stream: current sink/link/format and ordinary recovery identity
adaptations.status: Current TMDS SDR EDID/DDC/PHY/clock observation tested; board validator source connected, continuous binding not activated
differences: Read current retained immutable native blobs and direct physical DDC without property update or software override
Compare actual PHY readiness and clock with output format and AVI/HDR metadata
Reject unsupported FRL/422/DSC and foreign VRR ownership without forcing a lower quality mode
Fail stale generation/cookie/epoch and retain dirty ownership on recovery failure

mandatory_remaining: Actual ten-bit/HDR hardware validation and ordinary recovery after enabled VTEM/changed timing; current uncompressed TMDS SDR profile has real EDID/DDC/PHY/clock checks, unsupported profiles remain gated
Full cold-binding owner retaining device/module lifetimes and publishing bridge/PM guards before graphics
Requalification of a fresh native mode/link/HDR session after power/hotplug; never reuse a stale generation or ticket
Continuous native frame/deadline tests with ordinary compositor traffic and real enabled-VTEM recovery
Real kernel endpoint and HWC integration, functional Decode loader/selection/dependencies, boot and reboot rollback
Physical HDMI no-black and ten-bit/HDR acceptance with Frame Guard disabled
